title: Turbine Audit
summary: Windspine's survey crew audits the turbines before high season and four of them are wearing bird-nests of old fence wire, shrine ribbon and half a fridge door. Hop the row and the crest, strip the debris, leave the blades honest.

objectives.label: Strip nests from the lower turbine row
Strip nests from the ridge crest turbines

offer.text: Survey camp wants its turbines undressed before the season wind. Years of birds — or something with the same work ethic — have knitted four of them little jackets of wire scrap.
You'll need the hop. Nests sit high. Whatever you pull down, dump it at the camp — Pyke's people buy it by the armful, so the scrap pays twice. Once to them, once to me not hearing about it.

accept.text: Row first, crest second, watch the crosswind on the drop. And if a blade swings at you, duck — they're slow, not friendly.

complete.text: Four clean towers and a pile of wire the Reclaimers will frame a marriage proposal around. Good hop.
Something had built a whole pantry in the crest unit. I evicted a dynasty.
Congratulations, landlord. The turbines hum in a lower key now — even the wind notices good work.
